design_philosophy: Premium enterprise-grade Jewellery ERP SaaS platform. The UI must feel like Stripe, Shopify, Notion, and Linear. Minimal, modern, desktop-first. High-performance tables, white background, luxury jewellery theme without being tacky.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for ERP.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing for app frame, High Density Data inside modules. MODE B Grid for dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-[#E5E7EB] bg-[#F9FAFB] flex flex-col fixed h-screen top-0 left-0. Desktop-first.
spacing_and_layout.pos_layout: Grid split: grid-cols-12. Left 8 cols: Barcode input + Products Grid. Right 4 cols: Sticky cart summary, split payments, checkout CTA.
spacing_and_layout.table_layout: High density, strict grid. `border-collapse`, 1px borders, right-aligned monetary values, sticky header.

visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px solid #E5E7EB. Active states use 1px solid #0A0A0A or #B49042.
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal. Mostly flat solid white with subtle borders to structure hierarchy.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#B49042] text-white hover:bg-[#9B7B36] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium

components.cards: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-md p-6 shadow-sm
components.tables: shadcn Table customized. border-collapse. th: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#737373] bg-[#F9FAFB] border-b border-[#E5E7EB] py-3. td: text-sm font-medium border-b border-[#E5E7EB] py-3. Hover: bg-[#F9FAFB].
components.inputs: shadcn Input. border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-md focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A0A0A] focus:border-[#0A0A0A] bg-white.
components.chips: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[#F0FDF4] text-[#166534] (for stock/status) or bg-[#FDFBF7] text-[#B49042] (gold status).
components.modals: shadcn Dialog. bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg shadow-2xl shadow-black/10 p-6.

modules.dashboard: KPI cards with mini sparklines (Today's Sales, Monthly Revenue, Total Customers, Gold Rate Widget). Recent Transactions table. Sales Analytics chart using Shadcn charts / Recharts.
modules.pos_billing: Left: Barcode input + product grid (images). Right: Customer picker, Cart items, GST calc, Split payments. Big Checkout button. Very Stripe-terminal like.
modules.inventory: Advanced high-density table. Product image thumbnails in first column. Chips for metal type/purity. Filters on top.
modules.customer_management: Profile view with purchase history timeline and outstanding balance.
modules.settings: Tabs structure (Company, GST, Invoice, Users). Permission matrix grid (checkboxes).
modules.login: Split screen. Left: Modern retail architecture/jewelry image. Right: Minimal auth form, JWT login.

image_urls.description: Modern interior with minimalist white shelves
Silver diamond ring on black box

accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons. aria-hidden on decorative icons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').

motion.loading: skeleton loaders (animate-pulse bg-[#E5E7EB]) for tables and cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT create generic layouts. The UI must feel like a high-end financial tool (Stripe/Linear) meeting luxury retail.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Manrope for body text.
NO transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays. Always use solid white or backdrop-blur with white tint.
Implement the POS Billing module with a distinct Left/Right split view. Use a persistent fixed sidebar on the left.
Ensure high-performance tables. Avoid overusing React state for every cell; use Shadcn Table and optimize rendering.
Use standard JS files, NOT TSX.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use lucide-react for icons with a stroke width of 1.5 to maintain the thin, premium look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡�🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing for the layout, but dense spacing for tables.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
